// Open(code)Share — re:share, session sharing for opencode. Self-hosted
// replacement for the discontinued opencode share. Streams session events
// over one WebSocket per main session to an openshare-worker; viewers
// watch via hibernating sockets.
//
// This is the SINGLE-FILE build of the server plugin (generated by
// scripts/build-standalone.mjs — do not edit; edit src/ and rebuild).
// It behaves exactly like the package's dist/server.js.
//
// Install:
//  - CI / share-everything: reference this file in the `plugin` array of
//    your opencode config (no TUI part -> every session shares, the URL
//    lands in the log and optionally in `urlFile`).
//  - Interactive opt-in: install the package's TUI part (tui.json) too —
//    the server detects its presence and switches to manual mode
//    (`/share` + `/openshare` in the TUI).
//
// Config: env (OPENSHARE_*) > openshare.config.json (next to this file)
// > code defaults. Keys: servers (multi-server: url -> {token, code,
// label, active, adminToken}), workerUrl, createToken (legacy pair),
// shareMode ("all" | "manual"; default = TUI presence), debounceMs,
// completedDelayMs, modelLabel, ttlDays, openTasksInNewTab,
// authLogin, authPassword, spoolDir, urlFile ("none" = off),
// announceStderr.
//
